what: Anatomy reference: an MPFB (MakeHuman for Blender, extension 'mpfb' from extensions.blender.org, build 20261010) body tuned toward the bruiser, rigged with MPFB's Rigify human (toes) meta-rig and a generated Rigify rig, posed arms-down, plus a decimated low-poly version.
why: Evan asked for an anatomy check and simplification. A real human body built from a parametric model gives correct joint positions and limb lengths to check the bruiser against; Blender's Decimate gives the faceted look.
recipe: build_mpfb_bruiser.py (macros and detail targets are listed at the top). Run: Blender -b -P tools/bruiser-study/mpfb/build_mpfb_bruiser.py

outputs.bruiser_mpfb_rigged.blend: MPFB body in rest A-pose with the generated Rigify rig (bruiser_rig), arms posed down via the FK controls. Open this to re-pose or edit.
outputs.bruiser_mpfb.glb: 13,378 faces, smooth, posed relaxed (arms about 15 degrees off vertical, slight elbow bend), helper geometry removed
outputs.bruiser_mpfb_lowpoly.glb: about 1,549 faces (Decimate collapse, ratio 0.06), flat shaded, same pose
outputs.compare_turnaround_vs_mpfb.png: Midjourney turnaround (job 632f773e, image 0) front and side next to the low-poly MPFB front and side, same height

findings: The joint landmarks (shoulders, elbows, knees, ankles) and the leg length line up well enough to use MPFB as the skeleton and proportion guide.

Where the bruiser is deliberately stylised beyond real anatomy: a smaller, blockier head; much bigger forearms and hands; a deeper, more top-heavy chest and shoulder mass; a shorter neck. These should be done as deliberate edits on top of the MPFB body, not by pushing MPFB sliders further.
The relaxed arms-down pose now comes from the Rigify FK controls (upper_arm_fk / forearm_fk), not by editing the mesh.
next: When the Meshy key is available: run Meshy single-image and multi-view on the bruiser, then compare the Meshy mesh to this body for proportions before building the final low-poly model.

revisions.change: First MPFB body in A-pose; Evan pointed out an unintended artifact between the legs and asked for Rigify.

Genital and pelvis-bulge targets set to their minimum so the groin is closed and smooth (he wears shorts); Rigify human (toes) meta-rig added and generated through MPFB; arms posed down with the FK controls. Bug found and fixed: MPFB stacks two blended armature modifiers ('Armature' and 'Armature PV'), so applying them one at a time tore the forearms; the posed mesh is now taken from the evaluated object instead.
